svg.text: Hey, I'm Ayush – an engineer passionate about building tools that simplify people's lives.
I work at the intersection of AI, autonomous agents, and backend systems, and I write about
what I build and learn along the way.
I build software and AI-powered systems that solve real problems – and I can't stop.
Obsessed with turning ideas into products and understanding everything from first principles.
My goal is to help people and push the world further ahead than it was yesterday.
I want to be part of the generation that makes technology genuinely work for humans –
not the other way around. Humanity first, technology second.
Exploring emerging tech, competitive problem solving, fitness, and thinking differently –
